description: 60 Would You Rather dilemmas — pick a side, see how your choice stacks up against other players, and keep score of the rounds.

faqs.a: 60 dilemmas built in, from silly to deep — no repeats until you've seen them all.
Vote percentages are stored in your browser and update every time you (or anyone on this device) votes.
faqs.q: Where do the vote percentages come from?

faqs.a: Your picks are tallied per session so you can compare with friends.

howto: Tap the option you would rather do.
See the vote split for that question.
Hit “Next” for another of the 60 dilemmas.
title: Would You Rather Game
